result.topic_en: Four arithmetical statements, labelled 'old arithmetical conjectures': the order of the number of divisors of N factorial, the maximal order of the number of representations as a sum of two squares, the count of numbers of the form x^n+y^n below N, and an asymptotic formula for the coefficients of 1/(1-2x+2x^4-2x^9+...), followed by a computed table of those coefficients up to x^36.
result.transcription:
Add MS a 94 18(68) (68)

1. If $d(N)$ be the no. of divisors of $\underline{|N}$, then
$C^{\frac{N}{\log N}(1-\epsilon)} < d(\overset{\frown}{N})[?] < C^{\frac{N}{\log N}(1+\epsilon)}$          old arithmetical conjectures
where $C = (1+1)\sqrt{1+\frac{1}{2}}\,\sqrt[3]{1+\frac{1}{3}}\,\sqrt[4]{1+\frac{1}{4}}\,\sqrt[5]{1+\frac{1}{5}}\cdots\cdots$
2. If $S(N)$ be the no. of ways in which $N$ can be expressed as
the sum of 2 sq.s, then the \underline{max}. order of $S(N)$
$= \sqrt{\text{max. order of } d(N^2+aN+b)}\;.\;e^{O(\log N)^{\frac{1}{2}+\epsilon}}$.
3. Nos. of the form $x^n+y^n$ [-bess-] less than a [-given-] given no. $N$ (where $n>3$)
$= \frac{N^{\frac{2}{n}}}{4n}\cdot\frac{\{\Gamma(\frac{1}{n})\}^2}{\Gamma(\frac{2}{n})} + O(N^{\frac{1}{n}+\epsilon})$
[assuming the equation $x^n+y^n=u^n+v^n$ ($x$ and $y$ being different from
$u$ and $v$) has not got an infinite no. of solutions]
4. The coeff. of $x^n$ in $\frac{1}{1-2x+2x^4-2x^9+\cdots}$ is nearly
$\frac{1}{4n}\left\{\cosh(\pi\sqrt{n}) - \frac{\sinh(\pi\sqrt{n})}{\pi\sqrt{n}}\right\}$

$(1-2x+2x^4-\cdots)^{-1} = 1+2x+4x^2+8x^3+14x^4+24x^5+40x^6$
$+64x^7+100x^8+154x^9+232x^{10}+344x^{11}+504x^{12}+728x^{13}+$
$1040x^{14}+1472x^{15}+2062x^{16}+2864x^{17}+3948x^{18}+5400x^{19}+$
$7336x^{20}+9904x^{21}+13288x^{22}+17728x^{23}+23528x^{24}+$
$31066x^{25}+40824x^{26}+53408x^{27}+69568x^{28}+90248x^{29}$
$+116624x^{30}+150144x^{31}+192612x^{32}+246256x^{33}+$
$313808x^{34}+398640x^{35}+504886x^{36}+\cdots\cdots\cdots$

methods.what: Asymptotic bounds for the number of divisors of N factorial in terms of an infinite product constant C
Definition of the constant C as an infinite product of k-th roots of (1+1/k)
Maximal order of the number of representations as a sum of two squares related to the maximal order of the divisor function of a quadratic polynomial
Asymptotic count of integers of the form x^n+y^n up to N, with a Gamma-function constant and error term
Asymptotic formula for the coefficients of the reciprocal of the theta series 1-2x+2x^4-2x^9+... (overpartition numbers)
Table of the power-series coefficients of (1-2x+2x^4-...)^{-1} up to x^36
